statement: The 3rd day of a month is a Monday. The month has 31 days. On what day of the week is the 31st?

choices.misconception: I counted both the 3rd and the 31st, making 29 days, so I went one day too far.
I treated the 1st of the month as the Monday instead of the 3rd.
I moved on 31 days from the 3rd instead of 28.
I divided 28 by 7 to get 4 and moved on 4 days instead of 4 whole weeks.

hints: How many days after the 3rd is the 31st?
The days of the week repeat every 7 days. Find how many days pass from the 3rd to the 31st, then see how many whole weeks that is and how many days are left over.
From the 3rd to the 31st is 31 - 3 = 28 days, and 28 days is exactly 4 weeks.

solutions.reliable: From the 3rd to the 31st is 31 - 3 = 28 days. Since 28 = 4 x 7, that is exactly 4 whole weeks with nothing left over, so the 31st falls on the same day as the 3rd: Monday. The transferable idea: for days of the week, only the remainder after dividing by 7 matters.
solutions.elegant: The 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st are each one week after the one before, so all of them are Mondays, like the 3rd.

whyOnTest: Calendar questions test remainders on division by 7, and the distractors come from counting days off by one or moving the wrong amount.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
